_comment: Use this file to control visibility, count, and display order for ANY certification (whether from Credly, Microsoft Learn, or manual).

_instructions.title: Exact title or case-insensitive keyword match (e.g. 'Azure Solutions Architect' or 'Windows 7').
_instructions.displayTitle: string (optional). Rename or clean up the title displayed on the credential card.
_instructions.displayed: boolean (default: true). Set false to hide this certification from the visible CV grid.
_instructions.includeInCount: boolean (default: true). Set false to exclude this certification from the headline badge count (e.g. '47 verified credentials').
_instructions.priority: number (default: 0). Higher numbers display first. E.g. priority: 10 pins to the top; priority: -1 sinks to bottom.
_instructions.order: number (alternative to priority). order: 1 = 1st place, order: 2 = 2nd place.
_instructions.expiresDate: string (optional). Override expiry date (e.g. 'Jan 2028', '2028-01-15', or 'Never'). Setting a future date or 'Never' keeps an expired badge active.
_instructions.verifyUrl: string (optional). Custom verification URL (e.g. https://cp.certmetrics.com/... or custom transcript link).
_instructions.imageUrl: string (optional). Custom badge image URL or local asset path.
